drafts.text:
HOOK
Japan's latest inflation report is about to land, and it could set the tone for the yen.
[ON SCREEN: USD/JPY chart]
WHAT IT IS
The Oct inflation rate drops at 18:30 ET. Economists expect the year over year number to come in at 2.0%, down slightly from 2.1% in the prior month.
[ON SCREEN: Forecast 2.0% vs Previous 2.1%]
WHY IT MATTERS
This print matters directly for anyone trading USD/JPY or the Nikkei 225. The Bank of Japan is closely tracking price pressures to decide whether another interest rate hike is justified.
[ON SCREEN: Bank of Japan / Nikkei 225]
WHAT TO WATCH
Watch the surprise factor. If inflation prints higher than 2.0%, traders could price in faster rate hikes, which might lift the yen and pressure the Nikkei. A weaker print could ease hike bets.
[ON SCREEN: Market reaction levels]
CLOSE
Track the full breakdown on FXEmpire.
[ON SCREEN: FXEmpire logo]

drafts.text:
HOOK
Germany's factory sector is back in focus, and euro traders need to pay close attention right now.
[ON SCREEN: German flag and EUR/USD ticker]
WHAT IT IS
The German Flash Manufacturing PMI for Nov drops at 03:30 ET. Consensus expects a reading of 53.8, slightly down from 54.2 in the prior month.
[ON SCREEN: Flash PMI: Forecast 53.8 vs Previous 54.2]
WHY IT MATTERS
Germany is Europe's powerhouse economy, so its factory health sets the tone for the entire eurozone. For traders, this release can quickly steer intraday momentum across EUR/USD.
[ON SCREEN: EUR/USD chart with volatility indicators]
WHAT TO WATCH
Traders will watch how the actual figure compares to expectations. A surprise beat above 53.8 could lift the euro on signs of resilience. A clear miss below 53.8 could deepen growth worries and pressure EUR/USD.
[ON SCREEN: Above 53.8 = Euro Support | Below 53.8 = Downside Risk]
CLOSE
